h: Burna Boy's first sneaker collection with a Swiss running brand goes on sale
p: Burna Boy has launched a three-shoe collection with the running brand On, released on 22 October through the brand's stores and selected retailers. Prices abroad range from about $150 to $180, and Nigerian outlets are putting the local cost at roughly ₦202,000 to ₦242,000.
more: The pack comes in three styles, including a Cloudmonster and a Cloudtilt Remix.
The launch comes days after the singer's much-discussed reconciliation with Davido.
